object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests. In process: the tests read the folder the server keeps rather than the answers of a tool call, and don't run the installed program.
object.description: Start the MCP server without --repo-root, first with CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR naming a copy of the req-test repository while the current working directory is a folder outside any repository, then with CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR unset while the current working directory is the copy. Expected: the server starts both times, and the folder it serves is the copy.
